description: This file implements the HttpCache class, which manages HTTP caching, including cache entries, transactions, backend creation, and cache key generation within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: HttpCache::DefaultBackend
classes.description: Represents the default backend configuration for the HTTP cache, including creation of in-memory or disk-based cache backends.

classes.name: HttpCache::ActiveEntry
classes.description: Represents an active cache entry, tracking its disk entry, associated transactions, and state flags.

classes.name: HttpCache::PendingOp
classes.description: Tracks pending operations such as opening, creating, or deleting cache entries or the backend.

classes.name: HttpCache::WorkItem
classes.description: Encapsulates a single request to the cache backend, including the operation type, associated transaction, and callback handling.

methods.name: HttpCache::HttpCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HttpCache with network layer and backend factory.

methods.name: HttpCache::~HttpCache
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up active entries, pending operations, and cache backend.

methods.name: HttpCache::GetBackend
methods.description: Retrieves the cache backend, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: HttpCache::CreateBackend
methods.description: Initiates creation of the cache backend.

methods.name: HttpCache::DoomEntry
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as doomed (invalid).

methods.name: HttpCache::GetResourceURLFromHttpCacheKey
methods.description: Extracts the resource URL from a cache key.

methods.name: HttpCache::GenerateCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on URL, load flags, and other parameters.

methods.name: HttpCache::GenerateCacheKeyForRequest
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a specific HTTP request.

methods.name: HttpCache::ClearGlobalsForTesting
methods.description: Resets global variables for testing purposes.
